messages.content: You are an independent diagnostic reviewer of two failed rubric categories. Distinguish concrete unresolved defects from unsupported pessimism. Output schema JSON only.

Diagnose only the two F marks for exact SHA 515785504c3dbb4d68492cd34dd360cce992be21. Do not preserve an F unless you can name a concrete unresolved defect in the described implementation. A future enhancement or deliberately unconfigured paid credential is not a defect.

AGENT/TOOL GOVERNANCE IMPLEMENTATION:
- `approveProviderSpend` is reachable only through authenticated `/jobs/:id/approve-provider-spend`; service requires membership and role owner/admin; `confirm===true` and exact 64-char `scope_sha` required.
- `providerSpendScope` hashes job_id + job_revision + adapter/provider/model + request_sha256 + prompt_sha256 + complete estimate object + exact input hashes. `requestProviderSpend` clears any prior approval when this scope changes and sets AWAITING_SPEND_APPROVAL.
- `providerProduction` returns without calling generate when there is no matching approval. Missing Higgsfield credential is checked before the spend request can execute.
- adapter capabilities declare `paid:true` and `automatic_social_publish:false`; execution rejects a paid provider if these safety capabilities are not exactly present. Existing release still requires human Critic, independent verifier, final release approval.
- reference/mascot scenes are rejected before provider submit because this V9 adapter has no reviewed upload bridge. No fallback to text-only.

FAIL-CLOSED IMPLEMENTATION:
- Durable attempt `SUBMISSION_PENDING` is written before POST. If POST outcome is ambiguous, `PROVIDER_SUBMISSION_UNKNOWN` is stored and later execution sees SUBMISSION_PENDING without request_id and refuses to submit again.
- Once request_id exists, poll always uses that id. Transient poll errors schedule another poll of the same id.
- `nsfw`, `failed`, `canceled` terminal states are durable and later restart yields `PROVIDER_RETRY_REQUIRES_REVIEW`; no blind retry.
- crash after provider output collection uses exact output SHA + stored provider_execution provenance; recovery verifies artifact bytes and completes Graph without new submit.
- output URLs require HTTPS/no credentials, all DNS answers must be public, actual TLS socket is pinned to a validated address, every redirect is revalidated, redirect count/time/size/MIME bounded.
- credential missing/invalid, unsafe output, changed source/approval scope, reference upload requirement, artifact drift all fail closed with explicit codes.
- exact tests include stale-scope invalidation, duplicate-spend prevention, ambiguous submission, moderation, crash-after-collection, unsafe DNS/output and browser spend consent; all pass.

Initial rubric marked these F despite risk review P/NONE. Identify an actual defect if one remains; otherwise say NO_CONCRETE_DEFECT.
